segments.en: Hello.
Hello, who are you talking to?
I am talking to you, Rani.
No, I am not Rani. What is your name?
Karthik, what is your name?
You are not Rani. What do you do for work?
I work as a chief head in a company.
What about you?
I work in a real estate company.
Is that so? Are you single?
I am married and have a son. What about you?
I am single. I am 26 years old.
I am 36.
Okay, okay. You are 10 years older than me.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
Tell me, why did you come to this app?
I don't understand.
Why did you come to this app?
I just came here. Why are you asking me for the second time?
Oh, okay, okay.
My mind was upset, that's why I came. Why, what happened?
I asked you why you came. Everyone has a different purpose. I came for a good friend. Everyone has a different purpose, so I wanted to know.
How is this app?
I don't know, I don't come here often.
Is that so? Okay, okay.
What happened? Is your mind not okay?
It's nothing, my mind was just upset. I thought I would talk to someone, a stranger, it would be better.
Oh, is that so? Okay, okay.
What about you?
I told you, I came for a friend.
How is everyone at home?
Everyone is fine. Is everyone fine at your home?
Yes, they are fine.
What does your husband do?
My husband is busy with his work.
What are you talking about?
Why?
Some people live separately after marriage. We are married and living separately.
Why, what happened?
We have some money problems and understanding problems, so we are living separately.
Why don't you stay together in the same house?
Is there a fight?
Why would there be a fight? If we talk, there will be a fight. If we don't talk, there won't be a fight.
We are busy with our work. I work in a real estate company.
Okay, okay. Okay, okay.
If you stay alone at home, you will be more depressed, that's why I asked.
What are your children doing?
He is studying in 11th grade.
He is studying in 11th grade.
Okay, okay.
Tell me.
You tell me.
What did you eat?
Where are you?
I am in Chennai, a Coimbatore-based company.
Okay, okay.
Is it HR?
It's not HR, it's a team head. Companies give us projects, and we manage them.
Oh, okay, okay. You have to manage them under you.
Yes, yes. There are 26-30 people under me. I have to plan how to do it.
Is it a software line or another line? Financial?
It's a software line.
Software?
Zoho software, right?
Yes, yes.
That kind of software.
Okay, okay.
The team is mostly team head, so we have some financial level, like bank line. I have worked before, so I asked.
You are talking about telecalling, right?
No, there is telecalling, and there is team head. There are team leaders, team managers, there are many posts.
That is telecalling, call center, that kind of thing.
This is, we go to the customer directly and see how to use our software efficiently.
Okay, okay, okay, okay.
Tell me.
Tell me, you have to tell me.
Are you in sales?
Sales?
This is, now I am, me and my friend, another sir, both of us together, we sell other company's projects.
Commission based.
Okay, okay.
How is it? Every company, 10%, 20%?
The company gives, in Madurai, they give a maximum of 2%.
Maximum, in one, yes, 2%. Customer side, we take 2%.
The owner of the land, for company projects, they give according to the place. If it is a bit far, and the price is high, then 7%, or 5%, 3%.
If it is high, it will be 2%, if it is low, it will increase, right?
If the land is 10 cents, 8-9 lakhs, then it is difficult to sell that place.
No one will buy 1 cent for 8 lakhs. They will buy a flat for 8 lakhs, 2-3 cents.
So, at that level, if we finish that place, he will give 7%.
It will be rare to finish.
If we finish other places, they will give 2%.
Customer side, we take 2%.
Okay, okay.
There is some in Kanchipuram, but I don't know how it is, I have been thinking for a long time.
There is one ground.
Kanchipuram?
Coimbatore, right?
Yes, but there is a place in Kanchipuram.
How much, what is the rate?
I don't know, they are asking for 5 in the house.
5 lakhs.
How many cents?
I don't know the cents. 1600 square feet, I think.
No, I know, my friend is in Coimbatore, in this, real estate, so I asked.
Okay.
I asked if I could tell them, nothing else.
Two people are working there, in the real estate company.
They are saying they will sell the house, some are saying don't sell, they are saying sell it.
I can't do anything. If they want to sell with one mind, we can tell someone to process it.
That's what I said.
Because for me, only Madurai leads will come, I will only put Madurai.
Otherwise, my friends are in Chennai, they are also doing real estate. So if anyone asks for Chennai, I will tell them.
If anyone asks for Coimbatore, I will tell them, that's all.
They have some clients there.
If the place we say is okay for them, they will finish it.
If there is some income in some way, it is okay.
Okay, okay.
What did you eat?
I ate sambar chicken.
Sambar chicken, in Neyyattinkara?
Yes.
It's strange.
Why?
I have heard of afternoon sambar chicken, but sambar chicken in Neyyattinkara is okay.
I always eat rice at night.
Are you at home or in a hostel?
I am at home.
Okay, right.
In Neyyattinkara, afternoon is good. At night, chicken.
I rarely go to hotels. Once a year, they take me to a hotel.
No, that's okay. That's okay. Because most people eat sambar chicken for lunch, that's okay. Some people eat rasam at night and eat chicken.
We are like that.
Okay, okay, good habit. Good boy.
Are you joining the certificate?
No, I am telling you.
Usually, everyone expects this and that. If you say you will eat whatever I cook, then you are a good boy. A good boy for the future wife.
I will cook and give it to her.
That's what I said, you are a good boy, I asked you what you want.
I am learning to cook at home.
You have to learn.
I used to do non-veg before, I can do it well. I have been teaching myself.
Because the future wife shouldn't scold us.
I am telling you, the future wife shouldn't ask what kind of boy you have raised.
Don't ask.
